subject.main_character: A lonely 35-year-old Tamil village bus driver wearing a faded khaki uniform
subject.ghost: A pale, motionless passenger with wet hair, an old saree and unnaturally dark eyes

shots: 0-3 seconds: Wide shot of an old government-style bus travelling through a deserted village road at midnight
3-6 seconds: Close-up of the driver looking into the rear-view mirror and noticing a ghostly woman in the last seat
6-8 seconds: Extreme close-up of the mirror as the ghost slowly smiles
8-10 seconds: The driver turns around, but the driver's seat is suddenly empty; a ghostly voice whispers
composition.framing: Vertical cinematic composition, foreground shadows and deep background
composition.lighting: Dim yellow bus lights, cold blue moonlight and occasional lightning

action.sequence: The bus moves slowly through thick midnight fog. The driver notices a mysterious woman in the rear-view mirror. She smiles without moving her body. He turns around in terror. The driver's seat is empty, and the bus continues moving by itself.
action.ending: A whisper comes from behind the camera: 'அடுத்த நிறுத்தம்... உன் வீடு!'

location.place: A deserted rural road near Thiruvallur, Tamil Nadu
location.environment: Old roadside banyan tree, abandoned bus stop, paddy fields, mist and distant temple silhouette

aesthetic.cinematography: Slow tracking shots, subtle camera shake, dramatic close-ups

dialogue.voice_style: Soft, breathy, eerie Tamil female whisper

instagram.caption: அந்தப் பேருந்தில் ஏறினவங்க யாருமே திரும்பி வரலையாம்... 👻
